whenToUse: An accounting, bookkeeping or tax practice site that needs a service price list, a fee estimate and a monthly filing calendar.
Small professional-services firms that sell fixed monthly packages by company type.
avoidWhen: A wholesale or manufacturing business — use site-factory-01.
a11y: The fee estimate total and statement are announced through aria-live regions; motion respects prefers-reduced-motion.
